# REQ: LANG-1321 LANG-1322 LANG-1323
app [main] { pf: platform "https://example.com/basic-cli.tar.br" }

import pf.Stdout

Shape : [Circle F64, Rect F64 F64]

area : Shape -> F64
area = \shape ->
    when shape is
        Circle r -> 3.14 * r * r
        Rect w h -> w * h

main =
    name = "Roc"
    Stdout.line! "Hello, $(name)! Count: 0x1F"
